name: Wool Hood
description: A Skerrow hood, knitted while remembering. Keeps the wind of the chain bridges out of the ears.

name: Wool Tunic
description: Undyed clan wool. Every Skerrow child owns one; every Skerrow grandmother knows whose needles made it.

name: Wool Mittens
description: Thick mittens with a slit for the bow-fingers, in the Kharrow pattern.

name: Wool-Lined Shoes
description: Leather soles, wool uppers. Quiet on a boardwalk and useless in the marsh.

name: Leather Cap
description: Fernhold leather, oak-bark cured, with an antler toggle at the throat.

name: Leather Jerkin
description: A hunter's jerkin from the Fernhold lodges. Quiet in undergrowth, which the Woodfolk value more than thick.

name: Leather Gloves
description: Soft hide gloves, the palms doubled for the bowstring.

name: Leather Boots
description: Calf-high, greased against the Briarwold's rain. The seams are sewn with sinew, the way the Woodfolk do it.

name: Padded Cap
description: Quilted Brightwater linen. The watch wears it under the kettle helm and alone when the helm is in pawn.

name: Gambeson
description: Thirty layers of Brightwater linen quilted tight. The Tallymen's watch wears them under their tabards; a bravo's rapier finds them slow going.

name: Padded Gloves
description: Quilted linen gauntlets with a leather palm. Guild-issue, and stamped so.

name: Padded Boots
description: Quilted over leather, for standing on cold quay-stone through a night watch.

name: Warden's Kettle Helm
description: A brimmed iron helm of the Wardens of the Hearth, the brim wide enough to keep the rain off a roll-book.

name: Brigandine
description: Iron plates riveted inside leather, the rivet-heads set in the pattern of a bell. Wardens' issue; a Roll-Warden's has every plate named.

name: Brigandine Gauntlets
description: Plated leather gauntlets, the cuffs wide for a lantern-hand.

name: Brigandine Greaves
description: Plated boots and shin-guards. Heavy on a chalk road; welcome in a barrow.

name: Clan Bone Helm
description: An iron skull-cap under a crest of giant-bone. A clan's helm is passed down, and the dents are names.

name: Clan Plate
description: Iron plates faced with giant-bone over a wool arming coat. Made at Kharrow Hold by smiths who say the bone remembers standing up, and that this is why it holds.

name: Clan Plate Gauntlets
description: Bone-scaled gauntlets. The knuckles are carved with the seven clan-marks so a blow remembers who gave it.

name: Clan Plate Sabatons
description: Plated boots with bone toe-caps. Loud on a chain bridge, which the clans consider a courtesy.
